title: Escrow State Machine
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Escrow State Machine.
learning_objectives: Explain escrow state machine using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for escrow state machine
Assess failure and operational limits of escrow state machine
concepts_covered: A state machine is a set of checkpoints; each operation is allowed only at particular checkpoints.
States: Created, Funded, Disputed, ArbiterDecided, Released, Refunded; invalid transitions revert with custom errors.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
